title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin

extraction.summaryEn: Multiple election posters were damaged overnight across Berlin, including several in Lichtenberg, Pankow and Schöneberg; the State Protection unit is investigating. In Schöneberg, a 35-year-old man was found to have set a poster on fire and was taken to a hospital for psychiatric care.
